one_liner: Web scraping and browser automation platform ('Actors') with a REST API and a marketplace of pre-built scrapers.

auth.evidence_quote: Add the token to your request's `Authorization` header as `Bearer <token>`
auth.notes: Apify calls this credential an 'API token'; can also be passed as a URL query parameter (less secure, per docs). Also documents agentic payment support (x402, Skyfire).

access.notes: Free plan is $0/mo with $5 monthly platform credits, no credit card required, usable indefinitely, per search results; pricing page not directly fetched.

api.evidence_quote: The Apify MCP server enables your AI agents to extract data from social media, search engines, maps, e-commerce sites, or any other website using thousands of ready-made scrapers, crawlers, and automation tools available on the Apify Store.
api.notes: API organized as 'RESTful HTTP endpoints' per docs.apify.com; full endpoint count references an OpenAPI schema rather than a fixed number.

verdict.rationale: Free, no-card-required tier, standard bearer-token API auth, broad REST API, and an official MCP server.
